what: the hoard of a sleeping dragon, seen close, quiet and still: in front, one tall jewelled cup of bright gold with red gems round its rim stands upright on top of a heap of gold coins; behind the cup fills the picture a huge dragon's head lying flat on the gold, deep green scales, its one visible eye shut tight in sleep with a heavy scaled eyelid, a thin curl of pale smoke rising lazily from its nostril. Warm candle-gold light falls on the cup and the coins; the dragon is in soft shadow but its scales and closed eye can be read.
colours: Bright gold cup with deep red gems; warm gold coins; deep green dragon scales with pale yellow-green edges; a shut eye in a heavy green lid; a thin pale grey wisp of smoke; dark warm brown shadow.
must_show: a single jewelled gold cup on a heap of coins
a sleeping dragon's head with its eye shut
